real_computation.execution: Authorized Yaksa Windows computer, python source committed in PR321; separate real numerical execution not independently repeated in GitHub Actions
real_computation.unit_tests: 7/7 specialized source/rotational tensor tests PASS; general verify, security, train-audit pass

independent_structural_tensor.method: 128 actual C-alpha heavy atom locations of exact 1E5Y chain A represented as overlapping identical hydrodynamic spheres, projected Rotne-Prager-Yamakawa rigid grand translational/rotational mobility. eta set to unity for ratios; NOT official HYDRONMR or measured diffusion coefficients.
independent_structural_tensor.robustness_conclusion: Fast tensor axis and diffusion anisotropy ratio are numerically relatively stable against this restricted bead-radius change. Axis is almost identical to old CA PCA shape axis, which explains limited gain compared with previous PCA-based model.

training_evaluation.real_protein: Reduced Cu(I) Pseudomonas aeruginosa azurin PDB 1E5Y NMR BMRB6243
training_evaluation.retrospective_not_prospective: Original 800MHz data had already been inspected in prior azurin work; no new selection or hyperparameter choices from that test in this run, but this is NOT independent blind evidence.
training_evaluation.source_T1_T2_unit: seconds; R1/R2 = reciprocal with first-order standard-error propagation
training_evaluation.test_metric: Median over residues of sum of three squared standardized residuals at 800MHz (R1,R2,heteronuclear NOE); 0 means perfect; nominal SE are not calibrated covariances

hydrogen_direction_uncertainty.NH_angles_reconstructed_from: PDB1E5Y Cprev, N, Ca heavy atoms; H assumed ideal external bisector, all measured source residues happen to have geometric coverage; 123 reconstructible NH vectors total.
hydrogen_direction_uncertainty.selection: Use already frozen fitted RPY_CSA_VAR_REX0 500/600MHz site params, never refit while perturbing hydrogen vector or optimize perturbation to match 800MHz test.
hydrogen_direction_uncertainty.conclusion: Plausible illustrative 10-degree NH variations produce finite rates changes, but do not remedy many-large-SE experimental discrepancies; don't transform envelope into a statistical confidence interval.

independent_science_gate.physics_scope: An isotropic/axial spectral density model using one common tau per temperature plus fixed independent RPY ratio, ideal NH and bounded local S2/CSA cannot account for all independent azurin relaxation observables.
independent_science_gate.absolute_result: No residue in either 289K (116) or 317K (114) satisfies simultaneous 800MHz R1,R2,NOE within 2 reported SE, across all four preselected models.
independent_science_gate.identifiability_failure: CSA reaches upper bound in 67/116 and 98/116 at 289K or 50/114 at 317K. This is consistent with poor parameter identification or model mismatch, not measured CSA values.
independent_science_gate.Rex_warning: Selecting global Rex=1 s^-1 for one 289K variant from only training is a sensitivity to added model flexibility; no proof of microsecond-to-millisecond conformational exchange.
independent_science_gate.hydrodynamics_warning: CA-bead RPY is an approximating geometric hydrodynamics model, not independent laboratory measurement or state-of-art HYDRONMR. True diffusion may have translation rotation coupling, hydration, hydrodynamic modeling error and departures from axiality.
independent_science_gate.geometry_warning: PDB X-ray H positions are estimated, not observed; NH vector uncertainty assessed with finite angular grid.
independent_science_gate.data_warning: NMR field 800 has been seen in earlier study and is used only for scoring in this run, so no new blind out-of-sample scientific claim.

next_action: Independent hydrodynamic code such as HYDRONMR/GRPY with proper atomic bead shells and hydration and measured viscosity; obtain experimental cross-correlated rates or field-dependent exchange to constrain CSA and Rex, explicitly verify in independent proteins with new untouched field. Do not promote these models to Rowan FNII ensemble predictions.
